title: Treatment of CIK for Patients With Refractory Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to study the safety and efficacy of chemotherapy usage followed by CIK transfusion in refractory and/or chemoresistant lymphomas.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosed as non-Hodgkin lymphoma with negative effect of regular chemotherapy, and need further therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients refuse the therapy or have no tolerance for the therapy
